text: INT. HOSPITAL, MARINA’S ROOM - DAY1 1

ASHLEY WINTERS (18, innocent young woman, mature beyond her years, wearing a clean knee-length dress with long sleeves in light blue or pale yellow, fitted at the waist) watches DR. SAMUEL MITCHELL (28, male doctor, kind and upright) with deep concern as he removes his stethoscope.
Doctor, how is my mother doing?
Actually... I would suggest it’s better to let her go. MARINA WINTERS (41, janitor, modest) lies in bed, looking haggard, eyes closed, connected to an IV.
Even if the surgery is successful, the follow-up treatment will cost a considerable amount. It's a bottomless pit, and in your situation, I'm afraid...
No. I won't give up, no matter what.
Take some time to think it over. Also... if this month's medical bill isn't settled by the end of the day, we won't be able to continue treatment.
Samuel leaves, shaking his head helplessly. Ashley slides down the wall, sobbing. Marina slowly opens her eyes.
Ashley.
Ashley wipes away her tears, approaches the bed with a forced smile.
Mom, you're awake. Are you feeling bad anywhere?
Marina suddenly pulls out her IV needle, trying to get out of bed.
Ashley, let's go home. No more treatment. Blood seeps from Marina's hand. Ashley grabs her mother's arm, heartbroken.
Mom, what are you doing?
Marina yanks her arm away.
Enough... it’s been so many years. I've held you back for too long.
Marina tries to leave. Ashley blocks her path.
Mom, what are you talking about? Don't worry about the money. I'll figure something out.
Like what? Take on more jobs? Your body can't handle it! You'll die before I do if you keep this up! You're young—you should be like other kids, going to college, pursuing your dreams.
I can go to college anytime. Your health is what’s important right now.
Are you trying to annoy me to death? You've already got your college offer, why won't you go? I don't want you trapped here because of me. You should be doing what you want with your life.
Don’t be mad, Mom. I'll do as you say and go to college.
A text message alert sounds. Ashley reads "Come collect your paycheck" and her face lights up with hope.
Rest well, mom. I’m stepping out for a bit.
INT. HOSPITAL, HALLWAY - DAY2 2
Ashley leaves the room, spots Samuel passing by, and grabs his arm.
Doctor, please continue my mother's treatment. I'm getting paid today—I'll find a way to settle the bill, I promise.
Ashley gives Samuel a determined look, then runs off. Samuel shakes his head.
INT. ORION’S OFFICE - DAY3 3

A luxury office in New York. ORION VALE (25, business tycoon, brilliant and wise) wearing a bespoke suit, stands with his back to the camera, reading a paper titled "Incorporating the AI Era’s Technical Innovation into Long-term Macroeconomic Analysis." He turns while expressing repeated admiration.

This article forecasts global economic development for the next decade. It aligns with my thinking perfectly. Find the author immediately. JACK MERRITT (23, executive assistant, capable) stands by the desk with a tablet, pulling up Ashley's resume.
Sir, this paper came highly recommended from Harvard. The author is Ashley Winters, 18, a girl from the slums of Brownsville, Texas.
What? Only 18? She’s a genius, an absolute genius! Prepare the jet—I want to meet her right away. We cannot let talent like this slip away!
Yes, sir. Orion and Jack hurry out.
Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
INT. RESTAURANT, LOBBY - NIGHT4 4
VINCENT HART (around 40, corrupt businessman, slightly overweight, Ashley’s uncle) lounges in the reception chair, * feet on the desk, cigar in mouth, tosses two envelopes onto the desk.
Here's your wages for the month. And your boyfriend, Noah’s.
Ashley stands at the counter, happily taking the envelopes.
Thank you, Mr. Hart.
Ashley feels the envelopes, holding them up to compare thickness. One is noticeably thinner. She checks the amount written on her envelope: $2,500. Noah's reads: $5,000.
Mr. Hart, Noah and I do the same job. Why is my salary only half of his? Vincent takes a drag from his cigar, blowing a smoke ring, eyeing Ashley.
Don't be ungrateful, Ashley! I only kept you on as a favor to my niece. (violently stubs out cigar)
The fact that I’m paying a girl this much is an act of charity.
One should be content with what they have. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
But we agreed on five k. Why am I only getting half?
Vincent stands, approaches Ashley.
Why? Let me ask you—how many bathroom breaks do you take every day?
I’ve been on my period.
Then why does each break last over ten minutes?
Because there's always a line in the women's bathroom, but I've never let it affect my work.

Women employees are such a fucking hassle! I should've fired all you chicks, especially that pregnant one. Waddling into work around with that belly, can't do this, can't do that, “oooh, OSHA”— fucking * annoying.
So just because we're women, we only deserve half a man's wage? We deserve to be fired if we get pregnant?
Vincent leans in close to Ashley.
Exactly. I can't afford to keep dead weight, I needa make money! If you can’t work enough for your wage, then get the hell out!
Vincent glares menacingly at Ashley.
INT. RESTAURANT, LOBBY - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS5 5
But I handle more covers than all the male servers combined. I work one and a half times longer. I just want to get paid what I’ve earned.
Earned? Look at Noah—see how he charms the ladies, how many he brings in as customers every day.
Vincent points to Noah's photo on the wall labeled "Employee of the Month."
Then look at you— name a single customer who’d come here for you!
I'm a waitress, not a prostitute.
That's why you deserve less pay. If you wanna earn more, go work the * streets—be a shame to waste that * pretty face.
Vincent grabs Ashley's chin, examining her. She jerks away, furious.
I just want to earn money with honest work. *
Don’t you act all high and mighty. Your sick mother's in the hospital waiting for her bills to be paid, and you still wanna whine about your pay? Fine, then you won't get a single cent.
Vincent snatches the envelopes from Ashley's hands. She glares at him, eyes wide with anger.
This is illegal. Aren't you afraid I'll report you?
Hmph, nobody in this area would dare touch Vincent Hart.
Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
But it’s not like I can’t give you the money. There is one way... Vincent leers at Ashley's chest.
Spend a night with me. I'll not only settle your wages, but add another two grand.
Vincent corners Ashley against the wall. She backs away, terrified.
What do you think you’re doing?
Stop putting on airs. Dressed like that, you're asking for it.
Vincent tries to tear at Ashley's clothes. She struggles.
Help! Help!
Vincent slaps Ashley across the face.
Shut up, you whore. Everyone's gone home by now. No one to hear you scream.
Vincent continues trying to tear off Ashley's clothes as she desperately fights back.
No! No! Help me!
Keep screaming. It turns me on more.
No, no! Ashley's dress is torn, her voice hoarse, face streaked with tears. The door suddenly opens—NOAH FLETCHER (18, handsome young man, cunning) appears in the doorway.
Noah. Ashley's eyes fill with hope.
INT. RESTAURANT, LOBBY - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS6 6
Noah, help me!
What's going on here?
Vincent startles, then slaps Ashley across the face.
So young and already so messed up! You dare to seduce me?! I’m your uncle!
Ashley freezes, holding her stinging cheek.
But you were the one who— Noah walks toward Ashley.
You won't even let me touch you, but here you are hooking up with
Mr. Hart. What, only rich men are good enough for you? You're disgusting!
No, that's not what happened.
Ashley reaches for Noah. He jerks away in revulsion.
Don't touch me. You're filthy. RUBY HART (18, expensively dressed, arrogant and domineering) pushes through the door, looking confused.
Dad, Ashley, everyone’s gone home. What’re you still doing here?
This shameless piece of trash was trying to seduce Mr. Hart while no one was around.
(shaking her head desperately) That's not true! He tried to rape me. Noah, you're my boyfriend—you have to believe me!
You have the audacity to ask for my trust? I caught you red-handed throwing yourself at Mr. Hart! Ruby storms forward and slaps Ashley hard across the face.
You slut! You're my cousin, and you dare seduce my father!
No, Ruby, let me explain— Ruby slaps her again.
Still trying to lie your way out of this? You think the Harts are so easy to fool?
Ashley falls to the ground. Ruby loops her arm through Noah's, both looking down at Ashley with contempt. Ashley stares at them in disbelief.
You... you two?
I wasn't planning to tell you so soon, but since you've revealed how much of a whore you are, I might as well spill it: Ruby and I are together. So stay away from me, you bitch!
You've been betraying me all along? Why? Ruby leans down toward Ashley.
You’ve got the nerve to ask why? How could my Noah possibly stay with someone like you—a worthless girl who'd sleep with anyone for money? Ruby grabs Ashley's hair. Ashley struggles.

And now you dare seduce my father? I'll kill you! Ruby raises her hand to strike, but BEATRICE WINTERS (around 75, commanding presence) and SELENA HART (around 40, refined socialite) appear in the doorway.
Stop!
Ashley looks at Beatrice, eyes wide with terror.
INT. RESTAURANT, LOBBY - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS7 7
Ashley breaks free from Ruby's grip and runs toward Beatrice, sobbing.
Grandma, Uncle Vincent, he— Ruby shoves Ashley aside and takes Beatrice's arm affectionately.
Grandma Winters, Ashley waited for us all to leave, then tried to seduce my dad!
What? Selena steps forward furiously and slaps Ashley hard.
You shameless whore! Seducing my husband?!
Aunty Selena, I didn’t. Uncle
Vincent tried to assault me!
Selena glares at Vincent, who lowers his head in feigned guilt.
Darling, don't listen to this little Jezebel. She came onto me—you know her mother needs money for medical bills. She just wanted a bigger paycheck.
Aunty, that's not what happened at all! Selena hesitates, then slaps Ashley again, harder.
You vixen, always looking for a shortcut, huh? I'll teach you a lesson!
Ashley stands stunned.
You’re so young, and already turning to extortion for that sick mother of yours. How dark your heart is!
Disgusting. Sleeping with anyone for money— to think I was ever with you, it makes me sick! Ashley's eyes fill with hurt.
INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT8 8
Orion sits in the back seat while Jack drives.
How much longer?
Ten minutes?
Speed up. It would be impolite to disturb Miss Winters too late at * night. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
INT. RESTAURANT, LOBBY - NIGHT9 9
Why won't any of you believe anything I say? While he makes up nonsense and you buy it without question! What on earth did I do wrong?
Your mistake was being born worthless and trying to climb above your station! Think about it—Mr. Hart owns this restaurant. How could he be interested in a blue- collar girl like you? Pathetic!
So this is what you really think of me. I must have been blind to believe you'd stay with me forever.
Forever? I was just a lonely teen back then, and you were a bit of a looker. Who would actually want to be with you?
Ashley stares in disbelief.
Who knew you’d be such a hypocrite— such a prude with your boyfriend, while going after your own uncle!
I'll say it again: I did not seduce him!

Whatever. Let me tell you something—Ruby and I are about to join Brownsville's biggest corporation, DM Company. We're destined for heights you can only dream of, while you'll be stuck caring for your sick mother, rotting in poverty forever.
People like you— no conscience, no shame, no loyalty—no amount of money can hide how ugly you are.
You’ve got a filthy mouth, time to wash it out! Ruby walks to the side, picks up a bucket of dirty mop water, and dumps it over Ashley's head.
Ashley struggles desperately while Ruby and the others laugh.
You little slut, seducing your uncle—I'll skin you alive! Selena starts tearing at Ashley's clothes while Ashley fights back.
No! No!
Ashley falls at Beatrice's feet. Beatrice kicks her away.
Get lost! You've got the same despicable face as your vixen mother. Of all people to seduce, you chose your uncle!
I didn't!
Still denying it? I'll beat you to death! Beatrice kicks Ashley again. Ashley stands shakily, her eyes defiant.
I didn't do it, and even if you kill me today, I won't admit to something I didn't do.
So stubborn. We'll have to teach you a lesson.
Mom, let's ruin that pretty face of hers. That'll stop her from seducing anyone else.
I can always count on you for good ideas. Selena and Ruby grab Ashley's arms. Ruby grabs her hair and forces her face down onto the table.
Let go of me! Let go!
Noah, you do it. Ruby throws a steak knife to Noah. He picks it up and moves * to strike. Orion appears with Jack and two rows of BODYGUARDS (4 people), commanding the room.
INT. RESTAURANT, LOBBY - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS10 10
Orion gently drapes his suit jacket over Ashley. Her terrified eyes meet his. He helps her to her feet.
So many people ganging up on one girl—how very brave of you all!
This is a family matter. Who are you to interfere?
Kid, you sure know how to talk big. What trash heap did you crawl out of?
I’m not going to waste words on scum like you. Orion gently strokes Ashley's head. Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)
Don't be afraid. No one will dare hurt you again while I'm here.
Sir, who are you? Why are you helping me?
Because you're worth it. Orion lifts Ashley with one arm. Selena steps forward, blocking their path.
Stop right there, boy. This little tramp is part of our family. You dare take her without my permission?
I suggest you get out of my way.
What, you think you can lay a hand on me in my own territory? Orion gives Jack a cold, fierce look.
Handle this.
Yes, Mr. President. Jack signals, and the bodyguards form a line, blocking Selena and the others. Terror spreads across their faces.
INT. HOSPITAL, MARINA’S ROOM - DAY11 11
Marina lies in her hospital bed. Jack stands at attention nearby.
Ma'am, please focus on your recovery. Your daughter has been taken in by our president. She'll be attending Harvard Business School.
Marina nods, relieved.
INT. SCHOOL, LIBRARY - DAY12 12
Ashley, in collegiate clothes with a ponytail, searches * through books, taking careful notes at her desk.
INT. SCHOOL, AUDITORIUM - DAY13 13

Please welcome this year's distinguished graduate, winner of both the National Clark Economics Award and the Stevens Business * Excellence Award, Ashley Winters. Ashley, in graduation robes, receives her honors degree as the dean moves her tassel.
INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY14 14
Our target for next quarter is 10 billion. Ashley, in business attire, presents a PowerPoint. Two rows of EMPLOYEES applaud while Orion watches her admiringly.
INT. ANNUAL MEETING HALL - DAY15 15
Ashley, in a tailored suit, rings the bell celebrating AO Group's IPO. Confetti rains down.
INT. ORION'S OFFICE - DAY16 16
Sir, AO Group's net profit has exceeded one trillion dollars. Orion stands at the floor-to-ceiling window, turning authoritatively.
She hasn't disappointed me. Is everything ready? Blue Rev. (mm/dd/yy)

Sir, I've sent the share transfer agreement to your phone. The Blue Ocean Star necklace that Miss Winters has her eye on was secured at Sotheby's for twenty million. Orion (now 35, the richest man in the world, commanding and handsome) takes the NECKLACE from Jack. Its diamonds sparkle.
Excellent.
Sir, are you planning to propose to Miss Winters?

Ashley (now 28, AO Group Chairwoman, elegant yet humble) enters confidently in a tailored suit dress, perfectly styled with makeup and accessories, she strides ably and dominantly from the doorway to Orion.
Orion. Orion signals Jack to leave. Jack gives Orion a playful thumbs-up before exiting. Ashley watches, puzzled.
Darling, our ten-year agreement is up. I've exceeded all targets—isn't it time to let me go home?
You’re always so impatient. I've had Jack prepare the private jet. Orion affectionately taps her nose.
Look—I've unfrozen your funds, and transferred all my shares to your name.
He shows her his phone.
Now the world's richest man works for you. Mind if I become your trophy husband, boss?
Let’s wait for your performance review.
Orion opens the necklace box.
Isn't this the Blue Ocean Star I've always wanted? Orion fastens it around her neck.
Can I meet your mother now?
Don't forget, we still have that contract with the Arabian prince.
I'll come find you as soon as I'm done.
Ashley nods.
I heard your mother works at DM Company now. I've arranged to acquire it in your name— give her a little surprise.
Thank you, darling.
EXT. MARINA'S HOUSE - NIGHT17 17
Marina hurries home in her cleaning uniform, carrying supplies. She removes her arm covers as she walks, greeting two passing neighbors.
Getting off work?
Yes.
She nods and walks past.
Poor Marina. Widowed so young, and that heartless daughter hasn't visited once in ten years.
I heard she's working the streets.
Really?
Must be true. Her cousin Ruby saw her herself.
Marina stops and turns at their gossip.
Stop spreading lies! My daughter isn't like that!
The neighbors glance back before hurrying away.

Marina reaches for her keys but finds the door ajar. She drops her bucket and rushes inside to find the place ransacked. Selena and Vincent emerge, grinning, Selena clutching property papers. They collide with Marina.
What are you doing in my home?!
We're taking the deed, and we've sold most of what's inside. Take your things and get out.
Vincent throws a bag on the ground.
What? You have no right to take my house! No right to sell my belongings! Selena shoves Marina.
Get lost! Your house? This is my mother's property. Now that my brother's gone, it's ours.
Ben bought this house from Beatrice for Ashley. He paid for it!
Look closely—whose name is on the deed? Beatrice Winters. My mother's name.
We never completed the deed transfer, but the money was paid. Beatrice knows this!
I’m not arguing with you. Only the name on the deed matters. Vincent, let's go!
They head out.
With the deed, we can claim compensation for demolishing this place.
Stop right there! You can't take this house—Ashley won't have a home to return to!
Return? Hah! Your daughter's a prostitute in NYC, she’s probably in some man's bed right now. She's forgotten all about this dump!
Impossible, absolutely impossible. Our Ashley would never do such things.
Ruby saw her while visiting New York. She was getting into some rich man's car. Ruby even took pictures—what more proof do you need?
No. Ashley isn't like that.
People change. Who knows what crowd she's running with now? Heard she's doing drugs too. She'll die on the streets sooner or later.
Don't you dare talk about my daughter like that!
What? That trash can do whatever but we can't talk about it?
Why don't you join your whore daughter on the streets? Then you can have a family reunion. Then you two won't need this house, haha!
EXT. MARINA'S HOME - NIGHT19 19
Selena and Vincent leave with the deed. Marina lunges for it.
You've gone too far! Give it back!
Get lost! Darling, take her keys.
Vincent snatches Marina's keys, passing them to Selena.
What are you doing?
What does it look like? Keeping you out of this house. Selena locks the door, dangling the keys tauntingly.
Take them back if you can.
Marina rushes forward but Vincent restrains her.
Give them back!
Vincent throws her to the ground.
You're nothing but thieves! This is my house—what right do you have to take it? What right to sell my things?
Ignore her. Let's go.
Marina grabs Vincent's leg.
No! You can't leave! Without this house, Ashley can't come home!
Filthy whore, get away from me!
Vincent kicks Marina repeatedly as she curls up on the ground. He spits on her before leaving with Selena. Rain begins to fall as Marina lies there in pain.
Ashley, where are you? Please come home.
EXT. CITY - NIGHT20 20
A time-lapse of the city skyline, transitioning from night to day.
EXT. MARINA'S HOUSE - DAY21 21
Marina leans against the wall, disheveled and exhausted. Her phone chimes, startling her awake. She checks the message.
Mom, I'm coming home today!
Marina sits up straight, shocked and excited. Her eyes widen as she reads the message with trembling hands.
EXT. PRIVATE JET - DAY22 22
Ashley stands at the boarding gate, wearing an elegant silk scarf around her neck.
And I'm bringing my fiancé.
Establishing shot of the plane flying through the sky.
Wait for me at home, okay?
EXT. MARINA'S HOUSE - DAY24 24
It's Ashley... Ashley... my Ashley is coming back, and she's bringing her fiancé.
Marina frantically tries to smooth her hair with her hands.
No, I must get the house back. I can't let Ashley come home to nothing.
Marina heads out while speaking.
INT. PRIVATE JET - DAY25 25

Ashley reclines in a spacious seat, gazing thoughtfully out at the blue sky. ZOE ELLSWORTH (26, secretary, sharp and efficient) sits nearby giving her report. Ashley turns her attention away from the window.

Chairwoman, I got a message from Manager David at DM Company. He asked if we could celebrate their company's top sales performer at the upcoming signing ceremony. He hopes you'll do them the honor of presenting the award personally.
Fine, I'll give him that.
INT. PROMOTIONAL CEREMONY HOTEL, LOBBY - DAY26 26

The venue is elegantly decorated with an LED screen displaying "OA & DM Group Investment Ceremony." Guests mingle in small groups, drinking and socializing. A poster of Noah in his executive best stands at the entrance, labeled "Noah Fletcher - DM Annual Sales Champion." Noah and Ruby chat with guests, wine glasses in hand.
Mr. Fletcher, having the signing ceremony and your promotion ceremony on the same day - it really shows how much they value you.
I heard your promotion came directly from the AO Group’s Chairwoman herself - and she'll be presenting your award personally.
You're too kind.
I wouldn't be surprised if you became DM's next general manager.
When the time comes, Mr. Fletcher, we hope you'll remember us.
Actually, another VIP guest will be joining us today.
Could it be true? The world's richest man is coming?
That's right.
This Mr. Vale is even more intimidating than the AO Group’s Chairwoman.
They say he started from nothing at 19, then took the world by storm with his global empire. In just four years, he became the youngest billionaire in history at 21!
But this global tycoon is known for his incredibly high standards.
He rarely attends any ceremonies - the fact that he's coming today, Mr. Fletcher, speaks volumes about your future. Noah toasts with the guests as Selena and Vincent enter the hall.
Wow, so this is how a major corporation throws parties - such grandeur.
Of course! This is a signing ceremony by the world's largest financial conglomerate, AO Group. Absolutely luxurious.
Noah's really made it.
Ruby, you better lock him down.
INT. PROMOTIONAL CEREMONY HOTEL, LOBBY ENTRANCE - DAY27 27
location: INT PROMOTIONAL CEREMONY HOTEL, LOBBY ENTRANCE

text: Marina spots Noah's poster at the entrance.
This must be it. They must be inside.
Marina walks into the hotel.
INT. PROMOTIONAL BANQUET HALL - DAY28 28
Marina enters, looking around. Selena takes a pleasurable sip of wine, spots Marina in her peripheral vision, and sets down her glass with disgust.
Why is she here? Selena storms over to Marina, blocking her path with arms crossed.
Stop right there!
Selena, I was looking for you all.
Looking for us? Here? Do you have any idea what kind of event this is? Does this look like somewhere you belong?
This is Noah's promotion ceremony.
Everyone here is somebody important. A poor cleaning lady like you needs to leave. Now.
Selena, give the deed to my house back, and I'll go.
What house? I don't have anything of yours.
Ashley is coming back soon. I won't leave until you return it - she'll have nowhere to live. Selena leans in close to Marina's ear with a menacing whisper.
These are all VIP guests, and more important people are coming. If you keep making a scene, don't blame me for what happens next.
I don't care what bigshots are coming. You have to return the house today.
You're really asking for it! Selena violently slaps Marina, who staggers but maintains her fierce glare.
Vincent, the AO Group’s Chairwoman and the richest man in the world will be here any minute. Get her out of here before she embarrasses everyone.
Vincent grabs Marina's hair and starts dragging her away. Marina struggles.
Let go of me! I’m not leaving!
Ashley is coming back soon - I can't let her be locked out of her own home!
Vincent, release her.
Vincent throws Marina to the ground, wiping his hands in disgust.
I’m telling you, stop dreaming. Even when you're in your grave,
Ashley won't be coming back!
You're lying! Ashley just messaged me, she said she's almost here.
Marina, you're something else - you’d lie through your teeth for that shitty little shack!
I'm not lying. It’s all true.
Looks like you won't leave until we teach you a lesson!
What, you steal my house and now you want to beat me up? You think you're above the law?
Vincent kicks Marina to the ground.
I am above the law! What’re you going to do about it? You goddamn waste, you've lived long enough, and still don't know who runs things around here?
Vincent unleashes a series of brutal kicks at Marina, who clutches her stomach, blood trickling from her mouth. Guests nearby film the incident on their phones.
INT. PRIVATE JET - DAY29 29

Chairwoman, your mother is at the signing ceremony. Someone uploaded this video of her to Facebook - I think you should see it. Zoe hands Ashley a tablet. Watching the video of Marina being humiliated, Ashley clenches her fists so tight her nails dig into her palms.
Mom... Ashley's eyes well up with tears of pain and anger.
Those degenerates! How long until we arrive?
Still thirty minutes, chairwoman.
I don't care what it takes - get us there in fifteen.
Yes, ma'am.
INT. PROMOTIONAL BANQUET HALL - DAY30 30
I’ll tell you the truth - I already sold everything from the house yesterday. These jewels and accessories today? I bought it with that money. Haha!
What? How could you be so cruel!
Today’s fine wine is all thanks to your house playing its part.
Those were my things! You’re too much, how can you be so heartless?
My mother gave that house to my brother. Now that he's gone, it belongs to us.
That house was Ben's gift to Ashley.
Oh really? Then where is she? Go ahead, show me where she is! Ha!
She said she's coming back soon.
Stop pretending. Let's be honest - you just want money, don't you?
I don't want your money. I just want my house back.
Stop acting so noble! You're sleeping on the streets yet still trying to hold onto your pathetic dignity.
You know what, I'm not unreasonable. Here, Marina. Selena pulls out a stack of cash from her purse.
You want your house? Here it is! Selena laughs maniacally while throwing money into the air. Bills rain down, landing on Marina's face and body. Vincent and Selena laugh together hysterically.
EXT. LAWN - DAY31 31
A private jet lands on the grass. Two rows of bodyguards stand at attention on either side as Ashley descends from the plane, her face stern and commanding.
INT. PROMOTIONAL BANQUET HALL - DAY32 32
You steal my house, humiliate me like this - do you have any conscience left?
Marina lunges forward. Selena violently slaps her.
Worthless beggar! You dare give me attitude!
Marina crashes into a nearby table, sending a row of wine bottles crashing down. Noah and Ruby rush over at the commotion. Noah storms up and viciously slaps Marina across the face.
You old hag, how dare you come here and ruin my ceremony!
Do you have any idea how much that wine costs? At least a hundred thousand!
Old wretch, you couldn't earn that much cleaning a lifetime’s worth of toilets, but you're paying for every cent of it!
You splurge with my money, then demand I pay you back? Are you even human? If I can't get the house back, even if I die here, I’m not leaving.
You want the house that badly? Since we’re family, fine. I'll give you one more chance. Selena pulls out the property deed from her purse.
I want you to crawl to me... over this. Selena points to the shattered glass on the floor. Marina hesitates.
You’re really pushing it-!
What's wrong? You don’t understand
Mrs. Hart?
Gone deaf? Crawl!
Crawl, you old hag! Selena stands at the other end of the glass, holding the deed, looking down at Marina with contempt. Nearby guests laugh and mock her.
Crawl! Crawl!
That house was mine! Give it back!
Marina rushes forward to grab the deed, but Selena deftly moves away.
You're really pushing your luck.
Vincent seizes the moment to kick the back of Marina's knees, forcing her to fall onto the glass shards. Marina screams in pain.
EXT. HOTEL - DAY33 33

Three luxury cars screech to a precise stop outside the entrance. Six black-suited BODYGUARDS exit and take position. One opens the door of the first car. An elegantly heeled foot steps out as Zoe rushes to hold an umbrella. Ashley emerges, stern-faced, wearing an exquisite designer suit dress, silk scarf, and refined earrings - the very picture of authority.
INT. PROMOTIONAL BANQUET HALL - DAY34 34
The crowd jostles Marina, whose knees are bleeding from the glass.
Crawl! Hurry up and crawl!
Ashley strides in with Zoe, radiating fury.
Selena, Vincent, Noah, Ruby, and the crowd freeze in shock.
INT. PROMOTIONAL BANQUET HALL - DAY35 35
Mom.
